sheets.name: Carijó
sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG character sprite sheet for a Brazilian pixel-art farm adventure, Penas pro Ar. Create ONE new CAR IJO barred hen character, a charming adult hen with a plump rounded body, small expressive dark eyes with tiny highlights, a neat red comb and little red wattles, short golden beak, short ochre three-toed feet, and graphite gray feathers with distinct broad ivory barred stripes on neck, breast, wings and short fan tail. Clearly a hen, not a rooster, not a duck. Affectionate, alert and slightly cheeky expression, no angry eyebrows. Hand-crafted polished 16-bit pixel art, clean dark warm charcoal 1-to-2 logical-pixel contour, compact readable silhouette, limited warm gray palette, strong pixel clusters, discrete shadow tones, no painterly blur, no tiny noise. The bird must look lovely and identifiable at about 52 screen pixels tall. Sheet layout: portrait 1024x1536, EXACTLY 3 evenly spaced columns and 4 evenly spaced rows, TWELVE fully separated full-body sprites. Each column has a different stance: column 1 idle with both feet planted, column 2 walking with left foot forward/right foot back, column 3 walking with right foot forward/left foot back, modest natural wing counter-motion. Row 1 looks SOUTH directly towards viewer; row 2 exact right-facing profile EAST; row 3 NORTH directly away with NO face or visible beak; row 4 exact left-facing profile WEST. Same individual hen, exact same body size and proportions in every frame, only feet and slight wings change. Each hen about 220px wide and 260px tall centered in its own cell, generous completely transparent gutters between ALL cells, at least 40 pixels clear around sprites and all sheet edges. Keep the entire comb, tail, feet and every toe inside its own cell. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no colored background, no checkerboard baked in, no drop shadow, no floor, no scene, no text, no grid lines, no labels, no extra eggs or characters.

sheets.name: Sedosa japonesa
sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG playable hen sprite sheet for a Brazilian pixel-art farm adventure. Primary request: create a fluffy white JAPANESE SILKIE HEN, sedosa japonesa, as a beautifully designed new player character. She is a round powder-puff of warm ivory and white silk-like fluffy feathers, with a distinctive pompom crest that partly shades tiny curious black eyes, short dark slate gray beak, tiny muted mulberry/red wattles peeking through the fluff, feathered shanks and little dark gray three-toed feet partly visible below feather slippers. A fluffy short round tail, soft wings buried in puff, affectionate alert slightly mischievous personality. Must read as a Silkie chicken, NOT a sheep, NOT a fluffy duck, NOT a rooster, NO large red comb. Match polished hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art: dark warm gray outline, precise angular pixel clusters, clear limited ivory/cream/silver-gray shading, no washed-out white blob; body forms readable at 52 screen pixels tall. This is a game sprite, not a painted realistic animal. Layout portrait 1024x1536, exactly THREE columns and FOUR rows, 12 full-body sprites with no overlaps, clear transparent gutters. Row1 SOUTH front, row2 EAST exact right profile, row3 NORTH rear view with NO face or visible beak, row4 WEST exact left profile. Column1 neutral idle both feet down, column2 left foot forward right back, column3 right foot forward left back. Show genuinely distinct alternating feet poses and slight wing counter-motion; consistent individual, unchanged body proportions and scale all frames. Each bird approximately 215px wide and 260px high, centered in cells, at least 40px entirely clear transparent margin around each bird and sheet edges. Entire pompom, fluffy tail, feathery feet inside frame. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, no background scene or painted checkerboard, no ground shadow, no ground line, no floor, no text, no labels, no grid, no added items.

sheets.name: Galinha azul
sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite sheet of a playable BLUE HEN, a pixel-art game adaptation inspired by the Brazilian Galinha Azul from caldo Maggi that the user requested. She has an unmistakably round pear-shaped cobalt/royal blue body, lighter azure chest and cheeks, a few large navy blue spots on the breast and wings, small bright red scalloped comb and wattles, short golden-orange beak, small orange three-toed chicken feet, a little uplifted blue fan tail, bright dark expressive eyes with white highlights, playful self-assured friendly personality. Recognizably a funny adult hen, not a rooster, not a duck, not a baby chick; no white polka dots, no apron, no logos, no packaging. Beautiful readable hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art, compact rounded silhouette with precise pixel clusters, bold dark navy outline, saturated cobalt blue with 3-4 restrained shade values, not a smooth 3D render or vector illustration. Must read clearly at approximately 52 screen pixels tall and fit a charming warm farm game. Sheet layout portrait 1024x1536 pixels, EXACTLY 3 columns and 4 rows, 12 full-body sprites, all isolated with genuinely transparent alpha gutters. Row1 SOUTH front face toward viewer, row2 EAST exact right-facing profile, row3 NORTH rear view with NO face or beak visible, row4 WEST exact left-facing profile. Column1 calm idle stance both feet down, column2 left foot forward right back, column3 right foot forward left back, subtle opposing wing movement. Same individual and body size and head size in all cells, no morphing. Each sprite approximately 220px wide and 260px tall, centered in its cell, entire comb and toes and tail contained, at least 40px entirely transparent space around each cell and sheet edge. Genuinely transparent background, NO baked checkerboard, no shadows outside the character, no scene, no ground, no floor, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no additional objects.
